heading: From research prototypes to production
subheading: How I work, and why it matters

paragraphs.heading: The gap I close
paragraphs.body: Most AI never makes it past the demo. I bridge research prototypes and reliable production systems — AI backends that survive real traffic, handle millions of requests, and hold sub-100ms latency under load.

My focus is machine learning infrastructure, distributed systems, and production-grade AI pipelines that never compromise on performance, reliability, or stability. The model is the easy part; making it dependable at scale is the craft.

paragraphs.heading: How I think
paragraphs.body: I treat latency as a feature, observability as non-negotiable, and cost as a design constraint from day one. I'd rather ship something boring that runs for years than something clever that pages you at 3am.
